notes: «عائشة، زوج النبي» is written as the Prophet's wife; the stored HKG name for her is a different woman (see fix)

fixes.reason: The text names this Aisha as the Prophet's wife, but HKG attaches a different woman, Aisha bint Abdullah ibn Uthman

evidence.quote: عن عائشة، زوج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
عائشة بنت عبد الله بن عثمان بن عامر
